experiment.topic: ETH-USD hourly mean reversion to 24-hour moving average with 3% threshold
experiment.hypothesis: ETH-USD hourly price exhibits mean reversion to a 24-hour simple moving average with a 3% threshold, as measured by statistically significant price reversion in 1-hour intervals over a 100-period backtest window.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If the strategy fails to produce a statistically significant mean reversion (p-value > 0.05 in a t-test of price deviation from the 24-hour SMA) over at least 100 backtested 1-hour intervals with R-squared < 0.3 and Sharpe ratio < 0.5, the hypothesis is falsified.
